Many newspapers carried the story on Feb. 18, 1913; in addition to The New York Times , these included: The Chicago Record Herald The St. Louis Morning Star The New York Press The New York American The New York Evening Journal The Boston Morning Globe and Morning Post each reported the Boston openings at the Keith and National Theaters a week later, issues of Feb. 25, 1913 .
